Jinshu031:s0530 calls her 后妹午; s0579/s0581 link 午 and 趙粲 in the plot against the heir. Tongjian083:s0132/s0135 repeat the same named pair and plot.

Jinshu031:s0599 lists 趙粲、賈午 among those punished, and Tongjian083:s0260 records 趙粲、賈午 sent to 暴室 at the empress’s fall. The final Tongjian endpoint is the same named associate in this matching fall-of-empress episode.

Houhanshu084:s0251/s0254 identify 蒋均 at 耒陽 in a property dispute with his brothers; Jinshu053:s0017/s0065 identify the crown prince’s childbearing consort 蔣美人/太子保林蔣俊. The specific Chinese names, narrative identities and family situations differ.

Jinshu004:s0024 executes 中書令蔣俊 with Yang Jun’s group; Jinshu053:s0017/s0065 instead concern the prince’s childbearing consort, 太子保林蔣俊, killed in his deposition. Matching 蔣俊 does not erase the distinct office, gendered family role and purge episode.

Jinshu053:s0065 has 考竟謝淑妃及太子保林蔣俊 when the prince’s household is removed. Tongjian083:s0196 has 殺太子母謝淑媛及虨母保林蔣俊. Both name 保林蔣俊 beside the prince’s mother Xie in the same household purge; Jinshu053:s0017 supplies the childbearing consort context.
Jinshu053:s0058/s0060 and Tongjian083:s0185/s0191 match 黃門令董猛 presenting the prince’s letter and falsifying 長廣公主’s words on Jia’s orders.

Jinshu024:s0164 names 宦者董猛 appointed 中常侍 by 惠帝 in 元康中. The specific full Chinese name, eunuch status, same emperor/period and compatible palace service connect this record to the Dong Meng serving Hui and Jia; no incompatible person or chronology is evidenced.
